posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: I suspect Wrath of the Cosmos will be expected to be released this fall. Reason being, the Shattered Timelines stretch goal was for Sentinels expansions to be released half a year earlier than initially intended, starting with Vengeance. And that every expansion starting with Vengeance would be released roughly a year apart. After the announcement of the delay for Vengeance, I believe >G stated that only Vengeance would be delayed, not effecting the release schedule of all future SotM expansions. Since Vengeance was intended to be released in fall and if they are still going by what they had previously said, then it stands to reason that WotC will be fall. Which I totally hope it to be true, as I am totally stoked to finally able to have the full cast of Prime Wardens.
